capabilities: Embed canvases or single cards in notes with adjustable height, title, and card ID autocompletion
Interact with embedded canvases via panning, zooming, and card selection (read-only)
Preview canvases by hovering internal links through the Page preview plugin
Embed canvases inside other canvases with configurable nesting depth
Apply Advanced Canvas styling features to embedded canvases
extras: Uses monkey patching and internal APIs not covered by the public plugin API, which the README flags as a warning; nested interactive canvases are disabled by default for performance and can raise reload prompts when toggled alongside Advanced Canvas.
intentEvidence: this plugin already fulfills the need for a full preview of embedded canvas
problem: Obsidian embeds canvases in notes only as static, non-interactive minimaps, with no panning, zooming, or embedding of individual cards.

relations.evidence: Support advanced customization from Advanced Canvas.

summary: Canvas embed enhancer that makes embedded canvases interactive in notes with panning, zooming, single-card embeds, hover previews, and Advanced Canvas styling.
